inositol.key: Per 6 capsules: 3,902 mg myo‑inositol + 97 mg D‑chiro‑inositol (40:1), 200 mcg chromium (picolinate), 500 mg fenugreek, 300 mg Ceylon cinnamon
inositol.src: Label: scratchpad/labels/labels.json entry R279, from NutriDyn sell sheet 'Myo-Inositol Complex SS ND680' Rev. 2/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAzgNA). Serving 6 capsules, 30 servings: chromium (as chromium picolinate) 200 mcg, myo-inositol 3,902 mg, fenugreek extract (seed) 500 mg, Ceylon cinnamon powder (bark) 300 mg, D-chiro-inositol 97 mg (3,902:97 = 40:1). Directions: 'Take six capsules daily in two divided doses'. Size 180C: ND144 price list Rev. 10.1.26 (id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA7UcQ). The 3 + 3 split is the NutriDyn GLC 2023 PCOS protocol 'Myo-Inositol Complex: 3 BID' (scratchpad/protocols/metabolic.md section 3). Only the pcos sheet uses the 'inositol' key, so this merge changes no other sheet.
